questions: When the price of something goes up or down, do you want to change it on the list? If so, should the old price be kept so you can see what it was before?
Do some things have more than one price, for example one price for a single piece and another for a full carton, or different sizes of the same thing?
When you look up a price, will you type the full name exactly, or do you want to type part of the name (like "milo") and see everything that matches?
answers: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
